info.title: StarDeliveryServices
info.description:
API to play the Star Delivery game. 
These methods have what is necessary for you to play the game. 

The order for you to play the game is : 

GetPlanetsAndRoutes allows you to get the map necessaru to play the game. The Main Routes allow you to save 50% of the fuel. The Other Routes allow you to save 25%

GetDailyChallenge will show you the Challenge of the day, all 3 levels of it. With it you can use your map to build a route. Don't forget that it needs to start at the "StartPlanet", if it has Mandatory planets, they need to be included in the Submission route, and there can not be duplicated planets (except the StartPlanet at the end)


CalculateCoaxium will allow you to verify your route and understand if it's valid , and how much coaxium is being used.

Finally you can use SubmitChallengeSolution to submit a route and unblock your next level of this channel

Inputs: 'PlayerGuid' identifies the player, 
'PlayerEmail' confirms the player email 
'ChallengeId' identifies the challenge to evaluate

get.description:
Returns the active not finished leve of the current daily challenges available for the authenticated player. Inputs: 'PlayerGuid' identifies the player and 'PlayerEmail' confirms the player email used for authentication.

The output is a List of 3 Challenges, representing and order by the Level dificulty 1,2 and 3

ChallengeId - Identifier of the Challenge to use to submit the solution
ChallengeName - The name of the Challenge of the day with denomination for the level difficulty
StartPlanetId - The PlanetId from where the submission should start amd finish
MandatoryPlanets - List of the mandatory planets for this challenge (PlanetId,Name). This planets MUST be present on your solution.  Disregards the Bonus attribute
ForbiddenPlanets - List of the forbidden planets for this challenge (PlanetId,Name). This planets CAN'T be present on your solution. Disregards the Bonus attribute
BonusPlanets - List of the Bonus planets for this challenge (PlanetId,Name,Bonus). This planets contain coaxium reducing the you Coaxium spent in your route
IsFinished - Boolean representing if you have submitted a solution for this challenge level
Level - Can be Level1,Level2 or Level3. Each level can only be completed if the previous ones are already completed

PlanetOut.description:
Planet from the game where you go to do your deliveries. 
Each planet has an Id, Name , Coordinate_X, Coordinate_Y
Id - Unique identifier of the planet. Can be used to shorten the Json.
Name - Name of the planet. Also unique. More readable to humans
Coordinate_X - The planets are distributed in the galaxy in a 2D cartisian representation. This is the X coordinate
Coordinate_X - The planets are distributed in the galaxy in a 2D cartisian representation. This is the y coordinate
